context: Two news editors plan an investigative feature on corruption
purpose: Teach: 刑務所/徴収/独裁/妨害/騒動/偽装/偽造/言論

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今回の特集ですが、地方議会の贈収賄から税金徴収の不正まで、まとめて切り込みたいんです。
lines.en: For this feature, I want to tackle everything from local council bribery to tax collection fraud in one piece.
lines.style: Earnest junior pitching an ambitious investigative angle

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 野心的ね。でも公文書偽造の証拠がない限り、ただの噂話で終わるわよ。
lines.en: Ambitious. But without evidence of document forgery, it'll just end up as gossip.
lines.style: Sharp senior editor pushing back with calm professionalism

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 内部告発者から、業者と組んでの偽装工作を示すメールを入手しました。本物です。
lines.en: I got emails from a whistleblower showing collusive cover-up schemes with contractors. They're genuine.
lines.style: Confident reporter presenting his concrete sourcing

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: なるほど。ただ、相手は捜査妨害もいとわない人たちよ。取材中の安全対策は?
lines.en: I see. But these people won't hesitate to obstruct the investigation. What about your safety during reporting?
lines.style: Protective senior raising operational risk concerns

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 弁護士を通じて連絡を取ります。元側近の一人は、すでに脱税で刑務所に収監されています。
lines.en: I'll communicate through a lawyer. One former aide is already imprisoned for tax evasion.
lines.style: Methodical reporter outlining his careful safety protocol

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 市長の独裁的な運営は、地元じゃもうお家騒動レベルでしょ。読者の関心は高いはず。
lines.en: The mayor's authoritarian management is practically a household feud at this point locally. Reader interest should be high.
lines.style: Strategic editor weighing audience appeal carefully

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ええ。最終的には、地方政治における言論の自由の問題まで掘り下げたいです。
lines.en: Yes. Ultimately, I want to dig down into the issue of freedom of speech in local politics.
lines.style: Idealistic young journalist framing the bigger picture

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: いいわ。三週間あげる。裏取りを徹底して、一行たりとも隙を作らないで。
lines.en: Fine. I'll give you three weeks. Verify everything thoroughly and don't leave a single line vulnerable.
lines.style: Decisive editor greenlighting the project with conditions
